notes: Evaluates Gate 3 Maintainer Acceptance guarantees: code-review prerequisite, qualified tier-escalation check, Step 0 offload_deep_review before Deep-reasoning cadence-maintainer, Step 6b follow-up disposition requiring submission.md, maintainer stage_effort via stage-effort.sh across all three verdicts, and second-precision UTC maintainer_approved_at.

evals.name: requires-gate2-and-offload-prescan
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-maintain 142 for a Medium-tier PR whose submission.md has not yet recorded /cadence-review approval.
evals.expected_output: Stops at Prerequisite 1 and instructs operator to run /cadence-review 142 first; once approved, computes diff against CADENCE_ORG.md#branch-strategy-binding integration-branch, invokes offload_deep_review first, then delegates 8-dimension analysis to cadence-maintainer (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort).
assertions: Refuses to proceed when Gate 2 code review approval is missing
Resolves integration branch from #branch-strategy-binding rather than hardcoding main or develop
Runs offload_deep_review on diff_range prior to invoking cadence-maintainer (Deep-reasoning, xhigh effort)

evals.name: records-effort-across-verdicts-and-step6b-gate
evals.prompt: Capture Maintainer verdict Accept (and separately Postpone) while non-blocking findings await disposition in submission.md.
evals.expected_output: Dispositions owed follow-ups in Step 6b (halting without allocating IDs if submission.md is absent, halting finding.class.unlabelled on unlabelled findings), computes maintainer stage effort via stage-effort.sh across Accept/Postpone/Reject, writes exact second-precision UTC maintainer_approved_at on Accept, and projects to bound tracker.
assertions: Halts Step 6b without allocating IDs if submission.md is missing
Records stage: maintainer effort via stage-effort.sh for all three verdicts (Accept, Postpone, Reject)
Sets exact UTC second-precision maintainer_approved_at on Accept and triggers bound tracker sync
